proof_origin: Stage-3 decomposition of podIntegralHomComparison_laws (lem-pod-derived-automorphism-hom-evaluation, steps 8--11): its evaluation field. The formal argument is that of Stacks 0GMX: the comparison is a transpose and evaluation is the inverse transpose of the identity.
title: The integral comparison evaluation square.
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and $g:X\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$ an isomorphism of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Write $F=Lg^*$, $T$ and $H$ for the integral constructible pullback, tensor and internal Hom on its permitted Hom pairs [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations], $\mu_{L,M}:F(T(L,M))\cong T(FL,FM)$ for the canonical integral pullback-tensor comparison [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-construction], and $c_P:F H(P)\to H(FP)$ for the evaluation-defined comparison between the completed integral partial closed data on $Y$ and $X$, $c_P=\operatorname{tr}_X(\mu^{-1}\circ F(\mathrm{ev}_P))$ [def-sf-adic-closed-reindexing-maps, def-pod-partial-closed-interfaces]; a permitted pair $P=(M,N)$ pulls back to a permitted pair $FP$ [lem-pod-reindexing-hom-coefficient-descent]. Then for every permitted pair $P=(M,N)$ on $Y$, $\mathrm{ev}_{FP}\circ T(c_P,1)\circ\mu_{H(P),M}=F(\mathrm{ev}_P)$.

theorem podIntegralHomComparison_evaluation :
    ∀ P : (constructibleIntegralHomPairs l E Y).FullSubcategory,
      (canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l E g
          ((constructibleIntegralHom l E Y).obj P) P.obj.1.unop).hom ≫
        (constructibleIntegralTensor l E X).map
          (Prod.mkHom (podPartialHomComparison (podIntegralClosed l E Y) (podIntegralClosed l E X)
      (constructibleIntegralPullback l E g) (podIntegralPairs_pullback l E g)
        (canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l E g) P) (𝟙 _)) ≫
        (podIntegralClosed l E X).evaluation
          ((podPairPullback (constructibleIntegralPullback l E g)
            (constructibleIntegralHomPairs l E Y) (constructibleIntegralHomPairs l E X)
            (podIntegralPairs_pullback l E g)).obj P) =
      (constructibleIntegralPullback l E g).map
        ((podIntegralClosed l E Y).evaluation P)

proof.text: For any $f:L\to H(Q)$, parameter naturality of the transposition of partial closed data [def-pod-partial-closed-interfaces] gives $\operatorname{tr}(\mathrm{ev}_Q\circ T(f,1))=f\circ\operatorname{tr}(\mathrm{ev}_Q)=f$, since $\mathrm{ev}_Q=\operatorname{tr}^{-1}(1)$; hence $\mathrm{ev}_Q\circ T(f,1)=\operatorname{tr}^{-1}(f)$.

Apply this on $X$ to $f=c_P$, which by definition is $\operatorname{tr}_X(\mu^{-1}\circ F(\mathrm{ev}_P))$ [def-sf-adic-closed-reindexing-maps]: $\mathrm{ev}_{FP}\circ T(c_P,1)=\mu^{-1}\circ F(\mathrm{ev}_P)$. Precomposing with $\mu$ cancels $\mu^{-1}$.
